candidates.title: File:DFC 6137 Close-up of fresh cashew apples yellow fruits and shelled cashew kernels at a local market in Klet Kaeo Sattahip Chon Buri Thailand.jpg
candidates.creator: PattayaPatrol
candidates.description: This close-up photograph captures a striking contrast between two piles of produce, likely at a market in Chon Buri Province, Thailand. In the foreground, there is a collection of dried, wrinkled, grayish-brown objects that appear to be dried fruits or nuts, possibly dried longan or a similar tropical fruit, with their shriveled, textured surfaces showing deep folds and creases. Behind them, slightly out of focus, sits a vibrant mound of smooth, round, yellow-orange fruits that resemble fresh marian plums (maprang) or small persimmons, their glossy skins catching the light. The juxtaposition between the gnarled, muted textures of the dried items and the bright, smooth freshness of the yellow fruits creates a visually compelling composition that highlights the diversity of tropical produce.
